meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Assets managed by India's mutual funds at the end of each financial year
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 382 (financial institutions), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS); amounts in ₹ crore, counts as numbers. Each year is dated to its March; a bare calendar year in the source is dated to March of that year (the table gives no month).
